nodes.g: Ruth = "friendship" daughter-in-law of Naomi, wife of Boaz, and grandmother of David
to become a son-in-law, make oneself a daughter's husband
Naomi = "my delight" wife of Elimelech, mother of Mahlon and Chilion, and mother-in-law…
to perform levirate marriage, perform the duty of a brother-in-law
Orpah = "gazelle" a Moabite woman, wife of Chilion, the son of Naomi, and sister-in- law…
Boaz = "fleetness" ancestor of David, kinsman-redeemer to Ruth, daughter-in-law of Naomi…
